# Mcp

## MCP tools

What an AI client sees, listed at runtime through an in-memory MCP client. The surface is deliberately narrow (SPEC §7): no pinning, no hard removal by a model.

| Tool | Title | What it tells the AI | Arguments | Reaches | Cited by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="mcp-get-context"></a>[get_context](../../../src/delivery/mcp/server.ts) | Get context pack | Load the saved context pack for a project before starting work on it. | `project`?, `budget`? | [GetContextPack](use-cases.md#symbol-getcontextpack) | [Detect the project from the working folder](../flows/detect-project.md), [Hand off a conversation to another tool](../flows/hand-off-conversation.md), [Load a project's context pack](../flows/load-context-pack.md), [Serve AI tools over MCP](../flows/serve-mcp.md) |
| <a id="mcp-list-projects"></a>[list_projects](../../../src/delivery/mcp/server.ts) | List projects | List existing projects with item counts and last activity. | — | [ListProjects](use-cases.md#symbol-listprojects) | [List projects](../flows/list-projects.md), [Serve AI tools over MCP](../flows/serve-mcp.md) |
| <a id="mcp-save-context"></a>[save_context](../../../src/delivery/mcp/server.ts) | Save context | Save durable context about a project for future sessions in any AI tool. | `project`?, `content`, `type`?, `tags`?, `supersedes`? | [SaveContext](use-cases.md#symbol-savecontext) | [Detect the project from the working folder](../flows/detect-project.md), [Save context from an AI tool](../flows/save-context.md), [Serve AI tools over MCP](../flows/serve-mcp.md) |

| <a id="mcp-search-context"></a>[search_context](../../../src/delivery/mcp/server.ts) | Search context | Full-text search across saved context. | `query`, `project`?, `limit`? | [SearchContext](use-cases.md#symbol-searchcontext) | [Search saved context](../flows/search-context.md), [Serve AI tools over MCP](../flows/serve-mcp.md) |
